desc: Ideate complement symmetry and bounded enumeration: C(N,K) <= 10^6 implies min(K, N-K) is small, so enumerate the smaller side.
Implement Python solution with direct enumeration of the smaller side and total_xor transformation for the omitted case.
Test the implementation on the samples and edge cases: K = N, K = 1, N-K = 1, duplicates, and near-maximum combination counts.
